name: runtime-proof-output
title: Observability Operations Posture Metadata
description: Lane 4 and USF-159 metadata for logging, tracing, metrics, correlation identifiers, alerting posture, dashboard posture, incident evidence posture, and tenant-safe redaction. This metadata uses the existing observability-signal schema and records explicit source-issue boundaries with enterprise evidence rows usf-188-evidence-observability-operations-posture and evidence-usf-159-observability-operations-depth, without claiming live alerting, dashboard, incident-response, SIEM, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, or full React parity readiness.
aiGuidance: Treat this as Lane 4 evidence metadata only. Do not infer live monitoring, alert delivery, dashboard runtime, incident-response readiness, production readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, full dev readiness, or full React parity from this instance.
purpose: Record validator-checkable posture for logging, tracing, metrics, correlation id propagation, tenant-safe redaction, alerting reclassification, dashboard reclassification, and incident evidence boundaries under USF-188 and USF-159.
retention: Retain as repository metadata for the USF-159 bounded source-issue gate. Live alert delivery, dashboard runtime, incident workflow, retention purge operation, SLI/SLO operation, cross-tenant aggregate analytics, and live provider evidence remain reclassified as unproven and unclaimed unless a future issue authorises and proves them.
correlation: correlation-id, request-id, trace-id, proof-id, tenant-id, service-name, deployment-environment, provider-mode, and capability-id connect Lane 4 logging, tracing, metrics, audit, proof, and incident posture. Missing correlation evidence fails validation where Lane 4 claims depend on it.
